agency.name: National Enforcement Agency (NDSACEA)
agency.desc: Established under Bill H.B. 12, 2025 (Gazetted Oct 10, 2025) as Zimbabwe's central body to eradicate substance syndicates and manage rehabilitation.

divisions.name: Enforcement Div.
divisions.desc: Supply reduction, border monitoring & prosecution with ZRP.

divisions.name: Social Services Div.
divisions.desc: Demand reduction, public education & rehab integration.

items.label: Sec 156 Dealing (Non-Aggravated):
items.text: Up to Level 14 fine or up to 15 years imprisonment.

items.label: Sec 157 Possession/Use:
items.text: Fine up to Level 10, up to 10 years imprisonment, or both.

items.label: Sec 158 Cultivation:
items.text: Fine up to Level 10, up to 10 years imprisonment, or both.

zones.title: Uppers (Crystal Meth, Cocaine, Khat)
zones.keywords: crystal meth mutoriro dombo guka tik cocaine crack khat mairungi energy drinks uppers

items.heading: Crystal Meth (Mutoriro / Dombo / Guka)
items.law: Criminal Law Code [Cap 9:23] (Sec 156/157) & Dangerous Drugs Act [Cap 15:02]. Scheduled synthetic prohibited substance.

punishments.label: Dealing / Supply / Manufacturing:
punishments.text: 15 to 20 years mandatory imprisonment without option of fine under aggravated circumstances.

items.heading: Cocaine & Crack Cocaine
items.law: Dangerous Drugs Act [Cap 15:02] Part II. Strictly illegal Class A narcotic.

items.heading: Khat / Mairungi
items.law: Dangerous Drugs Act [Cap 15:02]. Scheduled plant containing cathinone.

zones.title: Downers (Heroin, Bronco, Alcohol, Benzos)
zones.keywords: heroin nyaope broncleer bronco codeine benzos mandrax valium inhalants glue petrol alcohol musombodia kachasu downers

items.heading: Prescription Cough Syrups (Broncleer / Bronco / Codeine)
items.law: Medicines & Allied Substances Control Act (MASCA) [Cap 15:03] & Customs Act.

punishments.label: Unlawful Import / Bootlegging:
punishments.text: Prosecuted under MASCA Sec 38/100. Fines up to Level 12, product seizure, and 5 to 10 years imprisonment.

punishments.label: Distilling / Selling Illicit Spirits:
punishments.text: Fines up to Level 7, destruction of brewing equipment, and 1 to 2 years imprisonment.

zones.title: Cannabis, Vaping & Tobacco
zones.keywords: cannabis mbanje dagga skunk vaping e-cigarettes tobacco shisha psychedelics

items.heading: Cannabis / Mbanje / Dagga
items.law: Criminal Law Code (Sec 156, 157, 158) & SI 62 of 2018 (Medicinal Licensing).
items.note: Industrial & medical cannabis legal ONLY under MoHCC licence. Recreational use remains illegal.

punishments.label: Unlawful Dealing:
punishments.text: Fines up to Level 14 or imprisonment up to 15 years.

punishments.label: Personal Possession / Use:
punishments.text: Fines or 3 to 10 years imprisonment (courts typically issue 6–36 months for small amounts).

punishments.label: Violations:
punishments.text: Fines for selling to under 18s or importing uncertified nicotine liquid.

zones.title: Gambling, Forex Schemes & Pornography
zones.keywords: gambling sports betting aviator mabhetis forex crypto trading pornography explicit media

items.heading: Gambling & Unlicensed Betting (Aviator / Dens)
items.law: Lotteries & Gaming Act [Cap 10:26]. Legal only via licensed operators.

punishments.label: Unlicensed Gaming Dens:
punishments.text: Fines up to Level 10, forfeiture of gaming machines, and up to 2 years imprisonment.

items.heading: Forex & Crypto Ponzi Schemes
items.law: Exchange Control Act [Cap 22:05] & Criminal Law Code Sec 136 (Fraud).

punishments.label: Unlicensed Dealing / Fraud:
punishments.text: Imprisonment up to 10 to 14 years & mandatory forfeiture of illicit funds.

items.heading: Explicit / Pornographic Digital Content
items.law: Censorship Act [Cap 10:04] & Cyber Data Protection Act [Cap 12:07].

punishments.label: Digital Distribution:
punishments.text: Fines or 5 to 10 years imprisonment (escalating heavily for offenses involving minors).
